provenance.conditions: Activated carbon (AC) 5 g/L, pH 5 +/- 0.02, 25 +/- 2 C, 48 h equilibration, concentration range 1-100 mg/L (batch, 150 rpm). Source: Heliyon 2024 Methods.
provenance.extraction: Transcribed from the EuropePMC full-text XML table cells (deterministic parse), Tables 4, 7, 8.
provenance.primary_source: Boregowda, Acharya, Jeppu, Girish, Prabhu et al., 'Adsorption of arsenic and fluoride: Modeling of single and competitive adsorption systems', Heliyon 2024, DOI 10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e31967 (open access, PMC11167366). This is the open-access experimental companion (activated carbon, As(V)/F, single + competitive isotherms) to the paywalled JAMM paper the request cited (Acharya, Jeppu, Girish, Prabhu, Langmuir 2023, 39(49):17862-17878, DOI 10.1021/acs.langmuir.3c02496), by the same group and using the same JAMM multicomponent model. The Langmuir 2023 table values were not machine-accessible (paywall); the same-system experimental constants and binary antagonism data are transcribed here from the Heliyon 2024 tables with exact table citations. NO synthetic points.
